value.signature: fn dependencies_match_supplied_commitment (proposal : & ProposalCommitment , recorded_dependency : & DependencyCommitment , opening : Option < & super :: DependencyOpening > ,) -> Result < OpeningComparison , ProfileError >

review.body: { if proposal . recipe != PROPOSAL_RECIPE || recorded_dependency . recipe != DEPENDENCY_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } let Some (opening) = opening else { return Ok (OpeningComparison :: Unavailable) ; } ; let computed = dependency_commitment (& opening . act , proposal , & opening . host_dependency_blinding_value , & opening . dependencies ,) ? ; if computed != * recorded_dependency { return Err (ProfileError :: Dependency) ; } Ok (OpeningComparison :: Matches) }
review.item_premise: The optional protected dependency opening stays private; the public C_D comparison reports absence or equality without placement proof.
